solutionSql:
SELECT shipment_id, event_id, status, occurred_at
FROM (
  SELECT shipment_id, id AS event_id, status, occurred_at,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY shipment_id, occurred_at ORDER BY id DESC) AS rn
  FROM shipment_events
) kept
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY shipment_id, occurred_at, event_id;
notes: 678 scans minus 24 same-timestamp scans with the lower id gives 654 rows. A DISTINCT ON formulation agrees.
